input.business_intent: What is the most used payment method?

args.sql_query:
SELECT 
    payment_method,
    SUM(transaction_count) as total_transactions,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(total_transaction_amount), 2) as total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(total_transaction_amount), 2) as avg_transaction_amount,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(transaction_count) / (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) FROM payment_method_analysis), 2) as percentage_of_total
FROM payment_method_analysis
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY total_transactions DESC

SELECT 
    payment_method,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    SUM(total_quantity) as total_quantity,
    ROUND(SUM(total_transaction_amount), 2) as total_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_date) as distinct_transaction_dates,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_segment) as distinct_segments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_category) as distinct_categories,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_method_analysis), 2) as percentage_of_records
FROM payment_method_analysis
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY record_count DESC

SELECT 
    payment_method,
    customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(total_transaction_amount), 2) as total_amount,
    SUM(total_quantity) as total_quantity
FROM payment_method_analysis
GROUP BY payment_method, customer_segment
ORDER BY payment_method, record_count DESC

SELECT 
    payment_method,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(total_transaction_amount), 2) as total_amount,
    SUM(total_quantity) as total_quantity,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_method_analysis), 2) as percentage_of_records
FROM payment_method_analysis
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY record_count DESC
